name: hermes-skills-audit
description: Weekly audit of the Hermes_Skills repository: YAML validation, broken ref detection, description checks, header standardization, line-ending verification
script_description: Python script that validates all SKILL.md frontmatter, checks description lengths, verifies related_skills resolution, scans for broken YAML, checks line endings, and detects duplicate skill names
output_format: JSON report delivered via cronjob system
guardrails: no_agent=true -- script-only watchdog pattern, no LLM calls, no interactive prompts
enabled_toolsets restricted to terminal + file only -- no web, no delegation, no browser-use
Threshold-based alerting: 8 checks (6 threshold-based + threshold_breached + exit_code), all must pass
Exit code 0 = pass within all thresholds, exit code 1 = any threshold breached
Empty stdout from script = silent (no delivery) -- only fires alert on threshold breach
Model pinned with fallback: primary=qwen/qwen3.6-35b (provider=qwen), fallback=poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free (provider=nous)
Script runs in REPO_ROOT (.), REPO_ROOT detection via Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
Windows python detection: uses shutil.which('python') not python3 (python3 is broken Store stub, exit 9009)
File exclusion order: audit-skills.py find_skill_files() excludes .git/, .hermes/, profiles-export/, memories-export/, memories/ before parsing
Duplicate detection: audit-skills.py uses explicit tracking, not dict overwrite -- catches same-name skills in different categories
Script-field validation: find_stale_script_refs() checks frontmatter script: paths against file existence -- results stored in temps_scripts threshold
Frontmatter validation: validate_frontmatter() checks REQUIRED_FRONTMATTER={name, version, author, platforms} + metadata.hermes block -- failures stored in yaml_errors
Category check: find_category_dirs() checks DESCRIPTION.md exists for categories with >1 skill -- stored in missing_category_descriptions (reported but not threshold-gated)
skill_view() sync: validate_cross_references() checks every skill_view() call has matching related_skills entry
Trend analysis: cross-run comparison of broken_refs, yaml_errors, skill_count, cross_reference_count
Regression detection: any metric worsening vs last run escalates severity from info to critical

expected_results.audit-skills.py: Exit code 0, threshold_breached=False in JSON output

validation_matrix.broken_refs: All related_skills resolve to existing in-repo skills (0 = pass)
validation_matrix.yaml_errors: All SKILL.md frontmatter parses + has required fields (name, version, author, platforms, metadata.hermes) (0 = pass)
validation_matrix.duplicate_skills: No duplicate name fields across SKILL.md files (0 = pass)
validation_matrix.temps_scripts: No referenced scripts missing from disk + no temp scripts in repo root (0 = pass)
validation_matrix.missing_body_sections: All skills have '## What This Skill Does' and '## When to Use' sections (0 = pass)

self_healing_actions.broken_refs_detected: Audit reports each broken ref with file path and skill name. Fix: edit SKILL.md frontmatter related_skills list to remove dead ref or add missing skill
self_healing_actions.yaml_errors_detected: Audit reports file path and error message. Fix: edit SKILL.md frontmatter YAML syntax (check for unquoted special chars, missing colons, inconsistent indentation). Missing required fields (name, version, author, platforms, metadata.hermes) also reported here
self_healing_actions.long_descriptions_detected: Audit reports skill name, current length, and max (59). Fix: trim description -- use abbreviations, remove leading 'a/an/the', drop redundant words
self_healing_actions.duplicate_skills_detected: Audit reports both file paths sharing the name. Fix: rename one skill's frontmatter name field to be unique
self_healing_actions.missing_body_sections_detected: Audit reports skill path and missing section. Fix: add '## What This Skill Does' and '## When to Use' headers to body

trend_analysis.description: Cross-run trend detection for skill quality metrics

tracked_metrics.skill_count: Total skill count -- growth rate detection
tracked_metrics.broken_refs: Per-run broken ref count -- regression if > previous run
tracked_metrics.yaml_errors: Per-run YAML error count -- should always be 0

regression_detection: broken_refs count increased vs last run -> flag as regression, list new broken refs
yaml_errors count increased vs last run -> immediate alert (schema regression)
duplicate_skills appeared -> new duplicate skill name detected, report both paths
skill_count dropped -> skills were deleted, report which categories lost skills
cross_reference_count dropped by >5 -> related_skills network shrank, check for removed skills
trend_analysis.growth_trend: If skill_count grows by >5 in a single run -> flag for audit (unexpected import burst)

regression_detection.description: Compare current audit results against last run to detect regressions before they compound
comparison_points: broken_refs: previous=0, current=N -> list the N new broken refs with file paths
yaml_errors: previous=0, current=N -> list the N files with YAML parse errors
long_descriptions: previous=N, current=N+2 -> identify which 2 descriptions grew too long
duplicate_skills: previous=0, current=N -> report all N duplicated names + their file paths
missing_body_sections: previous=N, current=N+3 -> identify newly missing sections
regression_detection.escalation: If ANY metric worsens vs last run -> severity='warning' in report. If broken_refs or yaml_errors increase -> severity='critical'.

auto_fix_suggestions.description: When issues are detected, the audit report includes actionable fix suggestions

fix_templates.broken_refs: Edit SKILL.md frontmatter related_skills list -- remove the dead reference or add the missing skill. Extract with: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d['issues']['broken_refs'], indent=2))" < report.json
fix_templates.yaml_errors: Edit SKILL.md frontmatter to fix YAML syntax (check for unquoted strings with special chars, missing colons, inconsistent indentation). Missing required fields (name, version, author, platforms, metadata.hermes) also reported here. Extract: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d['issues']['yaml_errors'], indent=2))" < report.json
fix_templates.long_descriptions: Trim description to <=59 chars. Tip: use abbreviations, remove leading 'a/an/the', drop redundant words. Extract: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d['issues']['long_descriptions'], indent=2))" < report.json
fix_templates.duplicate_skills: Rename one skill's frontmatter name field to be unique across categories. Extract: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d['issues']['duplicate_skills'], indent=2))" < report.json
fix_templates.missing_body_sections: Add '## What This Skill Does' and '## When to Use' sections to the SKILL.md body
fix_templates.temps_scripts: Remove or fix referenced script paths that don't exist on disk
fix_templates.missing_category_descriptions: Add a DESCRIPTION.md file to the category directory

skill_view_verification.description: Verify that skill_view() calls in body text have matching related_skills entries and vice versa
checks: Every skill_view('xxx') call in SKILL.md body has a corresponding related_skills entry
Every related_skills entry has at least one skill_view('xxx') reference in the skill's body text
No skill_view() call references a skill name that does not exist in the repo
No skill_view() call references itself (self-reference is a bug)

actual_audit_output.description: Exact JSON output structure from audit-skills.py (must match for cronjob threshold evaluation)
actual_audit_output.threshold_evaluation: Script compares each key in THRESHOLDS dict (6 keys: broken_refs, yaml_errors, long_descriptions, duplicate_skills, temps_scripts, missing_body_sections) against summary counts. If ANY actual > threshold, threshold_breached=True, exit code 1.
actual_audit_output.no_agent_compatibility: no_agent=true so the THRESHOLD dict is evaluated by the cronjob system from the JSON summary, not by an LLM
actual_audit_output.note: Issues like missing_frontmatter_fields, missing_category_descriptions are REPORTED in the JSON but NOT threshold-gated (not in THRESHOLDS dict). They appear as warnings in the report.
